resources.description: A single-cell atlas of tree shrew organogenesis, mapping cell-type-specific candidate cis-regulatory elements across three developmental stages.

resources.label: TOPA
resources.overview: TOPA profiles 3,656,332 nuclei from six whole embryos at E23.5, E25.5 and E27.5. It resolves 24 major cell classes and 197 cell types, and defines 1,238,436 candidate cis-regulatory elements.
